summary: XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing its board approved the cancellation of 11,791,755 Class A treasury shares, representing 2.3% of total shares, reducing the share count from 520,292,030 to 508,500,275. The cancellation is a capital-return measure reducing share overhang. No price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The transaction occurred on the filing date and has no regulatory clock. This is akin to a US issuer share cancellation. What to watch: future buybacks or additional cancellations as part of ongoing capital allocation.
